files.content:
import { Component } from '@angular/core'; import { AlertDialogAction, AlertDialogCancel, AlertDialogContent, AlertDialogDescription, AlertDialogFooter, AlertDialogHeader, AlertDialogTitle, } from '@/ui/alert-dialog/alert-dialog'; import { Button } from '@/ui/button/button'; import { NdAlertDialog as AlertDialog, NdAlertDialogTrigger as AlertDialogTrigger, } from '@ndop/primitives/alert-dialog'; /** A confirmation before signing out, with Cancel focused first. */ @Component({ selector: 'example-alert-dialog-demo', imports: [ AlertDialogAction, AlertDialogCancel, AlertDialogContent, AlertDialogDescription, AlertDialogFooter, AlertDialogHeader, AlertDialogTitle, Button, AlertDialog, AlertDialogTrigger, ], template: `

Sign out of every device?

You'll need to sign in again on your phone and other computers.

`, }) export class AlertDialogDemoExample {}
